name: The sixth key
description: An ancient artifact, older than Thran or Phyrexian make, that unlocks the vault and may be more dangerous than a key.

timeline.summary: Umezawa and Oko open a hidden safe behind the portrait and take the sixth key.
Kaervek reports that the artifact is not Thran or Phyrexian, and warns it could unleash another Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: You could be unleashing another Phyrexia on the Multiverse.

pages_say.description: A small, otherworldly artifact of blackened metal and fluorescent parts, one of the keys to the vault.
An ancient artifact, older than Thran or Phyrexian make, that unlocks the vault and may be more dangerous than a key.
